definition: Moveworks is an American artificial intelligence (AI) company headquartered in Mountain View, California.
details: It develops an AI platform, designed for large enterprises, that uses natural language understanding (NLU), probabilistic machine learning, and automation to resolve workplace requests. Autodesk and Broadcom are some of their client companies. Its platform analyzes requests made by company employees to its chatbot, and resolves them through through integration with other software applications. It is available in business communication tools such as Slack and Microsoft Teams, as well as through online platforms such as ServiceNow and SharePoint. As of its Series C financing round in June 2021, Moveworks is valued at $2.1 billion and has raised $315 million in total funding. The company’s investors include Tiger Global, Alkeon Capital, and other firms. In December 2025, Moveworks was acquired by ServiceNow.

explainer.lead: Moveworks is an American AI company in Mountain View, California, that builds an enterprise platform for resolving workplace requests. It matters as an example of NLU-driven automation in large organisations.

tiers.eli5: Employees type a request into a chat bot — like 'I need access to this tool' — and the system understands it and files the fix automatically instead of a person doing it by hand.
tiers.practitioner: The platform applies natural language understanding, probabilistic machine learning, and automation to employee chatbot requests and resolves them by integrating with other software; it plugs into Slack and Microsoft Teams as well as other channels.
tiers.paperLevel: Moveworks develops an AI platform for large enterprises that uses natural language understanding, probabilistic machine learning, and automation to resolve workplace requests, analysing chatbot requests and resolving them through integration with other software applications.

explainer.example: An employee messages the bot in Slack asking for a software licence; the platform interprets the request and triggers the provisioning workflow in the relevant application.
